name: the Title/Rating entries are dropped from the first render gate
why: Both render blocks are gated by a long 'anything to show?' OR. A Title column with nothing else to offer renders no section at all if the new entries are missing from the gate — silently.

name: ETI accepts any trailing parenthesized group
why: The style guide's ETI is lowercase. Without that rule an alternative title such as 'Cecilia (Does Your Mother Know You're Out)' is listed as ETI and lost from the single-title entries.

name: the lowercase-preposition exception is dropped
why: 'Nancy (with the Laughing Face)' is a song title; title case keeps 'with' lowercase. Without the exception it shows up as ETI.

name: titles split on a bare slash
why: Only the spaced ' / ' joins titles; 'AC/DC' is one name.

name: rating presence is inverted
why: The has/none decision is one selector test; inverting it swaps every count.

name: the medley prefix is not stripped before the slash split
why: Then 'Medley 1: Brazil' becomes a single title of its own and the prefix's colon reads as a subtitle.

name: the title highlighter is never dispatched
why: Filtering still works without it; only the marks disappear — the classic 'narrows but does not highlight' gap.

name: the title highlighter scopes to the whole cell
why: Scoped to the cell, a title match can also mark the same words in the relationship list under the title. The two-title spec reads marks inside the title element only, so it cannot see this; recorded as a known blind spot.

name: the subtitle setting is ignored
why: Each extra has its own setting; a gate that never reads it keeps the section on.

name: the Work flag ignores which column is Recording of work
why: Without the header gate the section would appear on every Title column, reading an arbitrary column.

name: the no-work flag is never applied
why: The row loop's else branch is the only writer; dropping it leaves every Title cell plain with no error.

name: the no-work tint loses !important
why: The sticky Title column paints its own inline background, and MusicBrainz's zebra rule outranks a plain attribute selector; without !important the attribute is there but nothing shows.
grep: exactly the rows with an empty

name: the no-work setting is ignored
why: Switched off must mean no tint.

name: the no-work flag is not restored from disk
why: Attributes are not in a cell record's html; without the restore a reopened tracklist loses every flag.

name: the restore accepts any saved value
why: A saved file is user-supplied data; only 'none' may reach the DOM.

name: the entity gate is dropped
why: Without it an artist or label name in a Name/Title column is parsed as a title: 'ABBA' becomes ALL UPPERCASE.

name: only Title columns get the sections
why: The configured column list is the whole extension; ignoring it silently reverts to Title only.

name: the column-list setting is ignored
why: A hard-coded list would keep the sections on columns the user removed.
